note: In-sample 2021-09-01 to 2024-08-31, 1 NQ, harness costs. Backtest dollars, not profit. 'pass_' = 50K evaluation pass odds (see prop_50k.json).

gates.sensitivity: no parameter whose +/-10% or +/-20% change drops PF below 75% of base ('fragile')
gates.candidate: pass gates, no fragile params, explainable in two sentences
gates.costs: 1 NQ contract, $5 round-trip commission, 1.5 ticks slippage per side, stop assumed to fill first if a bar touches stop and target
gates.source: nq-loop/backtest.py verdict() and CLAUDE.md, both last modified 2026-09-18 22:47, before the first logged result (22:50)

attempts.name: Opening-range breakout
attempts.idea: Watch the first 15 minutes after the 9:30 New York open. The first 1-minute close above that range (or below it), on the same side as the day's average price (VWAP), is the trade. Stop at the middle of the range, target twice the risk, out by 15:58.
attempts.gate_why: Profit factor 0.98, below the 1.25 gate. It lost money in every year (2021-2024). The AI: 'no edge as specified.'
attempts.note: Run with --no-log, so it has no row in results.md; numbers come from journal.md round 0 and the trade file.

attempts.name: Range filter scaled to volatility
attempts.idea: Same breakout, but the 'is the opening range a normal size?' check is measured against the last 14 days' typical daily range instead of fixed points, because the Nasdaq future went from about 15,000 to 20,000 during the test.
attempts.change: Range-size filter: fixed 20-150 points -> 0.10-0.75 of the 14-day average daily range.
attempts.gate_why: Profit factor 0.95, below 1.25, worse than v001. The filter hardly changed which days were traded (907 vs 889 trades). Branch abandoned: 'range size is not the discriminating variable.'

attempts.name: Only busy mornings
attempts.idea: Back to v001, but only trade days when the first 15 minutes are busy: volume at least 1.2 times its 14-day average. The idea: a breakout needs real participation to carry.
attempts.change: New filter: opening-range volume >= 1.2x its trailing 14-day mean.
attempts.gate_why: Profit factor 1.13, below 1.25. First version that made money in every year, but not enough. The AI: 'participation is the discriminating variable.'

attempts.name: Only with the overnight gap
attempts.idea: Busy mornings only, and only trade in the direction of the overnight gap: buy breakouts when the market opened above yesterday's close, sell breakouts when it opened below.
attempts.change: New filter: longs only on gap-up days, shorts only on gap-down days.
attempts.gate_why: Profit factor 1.47, the best so far, but only 180 trades, below the 200-trade minimum. Round 4 then ran the scheduled out-of-sample check on it (60 trades, PF 1.67), plus sensitivity and Monte Carlo, with no new version.
gate_harness: FAIL: <200 in-sample trades, not enough to trust

attempts.name: Trade until noon
attempts.idea: Same as v004 but allow entries until 12:00 instead of 11:00, to get more trades.
attempts.change: Entry window 9:45-11:00 -> 9:45-12:00 (plus a non-behavioural re-encoding of the time window so the sensitivity test means something).
attempts.gate_why: 194 trades, still under 200, and worse per trade (PF 1.35). The 14 added late trades lost: 'late breakouts are a fade, not a continuation. Abandon.'
gate_harness: FAIL: <200 in-sample trades, not enough to trust

attempts.name: Relax the volume rule (the false victory)
attempts.idea: v004 with the volume rule relaxed from 'at least 1.2 times average' to 'above average' (1.0 times), to admit more days.
attempts.gate_why: PASSED: 307 trades, PF 1.26 (gate 1.25, 'a hair over'). Round 7: out-of-sample PF 1.51 on 108 trades, no fragile parameters, Monte Carlo fine. CLAUDE.md's stop rule triggered. The AI also wrote 'Dilution, not edge' about the 127 added trades. In round 8 it found the Monday bug in this version.

attempts.name: Monday bug fixed
attempts.idea: v006 with its own bug fixed: the daily numbers are now built only from real trading sessions, so Mondays and days after holidays can trade and the volume average is honest.
attempts.change: Bug fix: daily series (opening volume, prior close, gap) built over trading sessions only.
attempts.gate_why: PASSED: 223 trades, PF 1.29; out-of-sample PF 1.46 on 72 trades; no fragile parameters. Fewer trades than v006 because the volume bar is now really 1.0x. The 40 Monday trades it gained roughly washed (PF 0.92).
